name: Cross-Molecular-Benchmark
description: A benchmark intended to evaluate models on cross-molecular tasks that require generalization across different molecular datasets and representation types. It measures performance on property prediction and classification tasks across diverse molecule sets, assessing robustness to distribution shift and representation changes. The benchmark is oriented toward evaluating machine learning models for chemical/molecular understanding and predictive accuracy.
reputation: Relatively low community visibility compared with major chemistry benchmarks; appears to be a specialized dataset with limited adoption.
